title: PVTSizing 2.0: A Fast and Reliable Analog Circuit Sizing Operator for Agentic EDA Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.22328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog circuit design automation requires both coordinated tool execution and efficient numerical search. Large language models (LLMs) offer new ways to organize tool execution, but finding one sizing that satisfies specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners remains costly. PVTSizing 2.0 addresses these needs through a human-agent workflow built around an independently usable numerical optimizer. An agent carries the designer's approved task through execution and result review. The optimizer reduces unnecessary training through loss-guided updates and uses critic-guided local refinement to explore additional candidates while accounting for cross-corner conflicts. An optional LLM adviser supplies parameter relationships to focus numerical search on circuit-informed directions, while the optimizer selects adjustment amplitudes and verifies their effects through simulation. translated_title: PVTSizing 2.0：面向智能体EDA工作流的快速可靠模拟电路尺寸设计算子
translated_abstract: 模拟电路设计自动化既需要协调的工具执行，也需要高效的数值搜索。大型语言模型（LLM）为组织工具执行提供了新的途径，但找到一个在工艺、电压和温度（PVT）各角点上均满足规格的尺寸设计方案仍然代价高昂。PVTSizing 2.0 通过一个围绕可独立使用的数值优化器构建的人-智能体协作工作流来满足这些需求。智能体负责执行设计者批准的任务并进行结果审查。优化器通过损失引导的更新减少不必要的训练，并采用评论家引导的局部细化来探索更多候选方案，同时兼顾跨角点之间的冲突。可选的 LLM 顾问提供参数之间的关系，将数值搜索聚焦于基于电路知识的方向，而优化器则负责选择调整幅度并通过仿真验证其效果。在四个电路基准测试中……（摘要内容不完整，在此截断）
tldr: PVTSizing 2.0 提出了一个围绕可独立使用数值优化器构建的人-智能体协作工作流，结合损失引导更新、评论家引导的局部细化以及可选的 LLM 顾问，实现了快速可靠的跨 PVT 角点模拟电路尺寸设计。
en_tdlr: PVTSizing 2.0 presents a human-agent workflow built around an independently usable numerical optimizer, combining loss-guided updates, critic-guided local refinement, and an optional LLM adviser to achieve fast and reliable analog circuit sizing across PVT corners.
